strategies.entry_rule: Long when fast SMA exceeds slow SMA, evaluated on completed closes.

strategies.failure_modes: Whipsaws, lag and corporate-action errors.

strategies.entry_rule: Long at the official published resumption time only, sized by the venue's consumed displayed size; no trading while the official feed shows the symbol halted.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit two hours after resumption or at the next documented early-close start, whichever is first.

strategies.failure_modes: Requires official intraday quotes with quote condition and liquidity flags around resumption; a daily-bar approximation of a resumption print would be invented data. Only current halts are enumerable, so no honest backtest exists yet.

strategies.entry_rule: Long the broad ETF two documented sessions before a market holiday, using the exchange's own calendar (never an inferred weekday).
strategies.exit_rule: Exit at the close of the first documented session after the holiday.
strategies.hypothesis: Pre-holiday drift is a long-studied seasonality; the venue-admin calendar now supplies the event dates from the exchange's own page.
strategies.failure_modes: A daily close-to-close backtest needs official daily bars with redistribution rights (the P0 blocker), and the documented holiday effect may not survive spreads, fees and selection of one broad instrument.

strategies.entry_rule: Hold positions only across sessions where the trade date and the settlement date are both documented; explicitly stand aside for cash movements that would span days when Fedwire is closed but markets are open (the two calendars disagree in exactly four 2026 windows).
strategies.exit_rule: Re-enter on the first fully documented trade/settlement pair.
strategies.hypothesis: Funding timing around settlement holidays affects real carry; keeping the two official calendars separate is what the June/July 2026 Independence-Day window exercises.
strategies.failure_modes: The edge is a financing detail, not a price prediction: it cannot show up as a return on a cash-only long-only book, so the honest expectation is near-zero; it exists to test that the dual-calendar plumbing never trades or settles on an undocumented day.

strategies.entry_rule: Stand down (no new orders) in any symbol with a sourced corporate action inside +/-1 session of the order date; the CorporateActionTable in sim/venue_admin refuses unsourced rows, so this rule can only fire on real filings.
strategies.exit_rule: Resume the session after the documented ex-date.
strategies.hypothesis: Prices paid across unadjusted splits and ex-dates are the classic way a paper book silently doubles its holdings; standing down is cheaper than being wrong.
strategies.failure_modes: The corporate-actions table is deliberately empty until the EDGAR-driven collection workflow exists (next session), so today the rule never fires and that emptiness is shown rather than filled with guesses.
